metadata.name: Concrete Annex
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A buried concrete works: two high hangars with galleries face each other across a central hall, where a raised walkway crosses over the pillars and a pit drops to tunnels underneath. Long hard-cornered corridors loop round everything on two levels, with windows and firing slits into every big room; ramps and stairwells at the corners tie the levels together. Heavy armour waits on the walkway, a rocket launcher at the bottom of the pit.
